indication.text: STELARA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients (18 years or older) with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who are candidates for phototherapy or systemic therapy.

citations.quote: STELARA™ is a human interleukin-12 and -23 antagonist indicated for the treatment of adult patients (18 years or older) with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who are candidates for phototherapy or systemic therapy. (1)

target_moa.text: Ustekinumab is a fully humanized IgG1 kappa monoclonal antibody that binds with high affinity to the p40 subunit shared by interleukin (IL)-12 and IL-23, neutralizing their bioactivity and preventing binding to the IL-12RB1 receptor on immune cells.

citations.quote: Ustekinumab is a fully humanized IgG1κ monoclonal antibody that binds to the p40 subunit of interleukin (IL)-12 and IL-23.

Ustekinumab binds with high affinity to human IL-12 and IL-23 and neutralizes their bioactivity preventing these cytokines from binding to their IL-12RB1 (IL-12 receptor beta-1) receptor protein expressed on the surface of immune cells.

modality.text: mAb (fully humanized IgG1 kappa monoclonal antibody)

citations.quote: Ustekinumab is a fully humanized IgG1κ monoclonal antibody that binds to the p40 subunit of interleukin (IL)-12 and IL-23.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >3% and greater than placebo): nasopharyngitis, upper respiratory tract infection, headache, and fatigue. Serious risks of concern include serious infections and malignancies; one case of reversible posterior leukoencephalopathy syndrome (RPLS) was reported among 3523 STELARA-treated subjects.
